comment: Sketch with many patterned circles (mitcad#670): one circle (c1, centre p2) drawn as the Circle tool draws it, then a 10 x 10 rectangular pattern of it, 100 circles. Run with mitcad-cli run --timings: the time of the pattern, of a full solve (the spacing changed), of single drag steps of the original's centre (all copies follow) and of its radius. perf_sketch_pattern_5.json and _20.json are the same at 25 and 400 circles.
A full solve: the spacing of the first direction changed, every copy moves.
Drag steps of the original's centre, as the app sends one per mouse move.
Drag steps of the original circle itself: its radius, all copies follow.
The sketch as the app reads it after every step, then again unchanged (mitcad#679: the answer kept).
